about.title: About Us
about.lead: The first educational institute in the UAE founded to serve the children of the Egyptian community and Egyptian Embassy students.
about.storyTitle: A story that began with every Egyptian family's question abroad
story: How can our children keep their country's curriculum, language and identity while living far from Egypt? From that question, Abnauona Institute Abroad was born in the Emirate of Ajman — the first educational institute in the UAE dedicated to serving the children of the Egyptian community and Egyptian Embassy students.

We teach the official Egyptian curriculum, in both Arabic and Languages tracks, from kindergarten to secondary school. Our outstanding teachers know the curriculum and know their students, and we prepare students for the official exams in coordination with the Embassy.

Within walls that carry the spirit of Egyptian temples — glowing lotus columns and ornate gates — our children learn, draw, play music, compete and celebrate, growing up knowing who they are and where they come from.
about.vision: To be the first educational home for every Egyptian family in the UAE — graduating an outstanding generation, proud of its identity and ready to compete anywhere.
about.mission: To deliver authentic, high-quality Egyptian education in a safe and inspiring environment, through outstanding teachers, talent-building activities and a genuine partnership with families.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.lead: Quick answers to what parents ask most. Can't find your answer? Message us on WhatsApp.
faq.stillText: Our team will reply on WhatsApp as soon as possible.

items.q: Which curriculum does the institute teach?
items.a: We teach the official Egyptian curriculum in both tracks (Arabic and Languages) from Pre KG to secondary, delivered by teachers who specialise in the Egyptian curriculum.

items.q: What is the difference between the Arabic and Languages tracks?
items.a: In the Arabic track, subjects are taught in Arabic with English as a core subject. In the Languages track, maths and science are taught in English following the Egyptian language-schools curriculum.

items.q: How do exams work in coordination with the Embassy?
items.a: Students study the curriculum at the institute throughout the year, and we prepare them for the official exams for Egyptian students abroad, which are held in coordination with the Egyptian Embassy. We keep parents informed of dates and procedures and run revision sessions and mock exams beforehand.

items.q: Is transport available, and which areas does it cover?
items.a: Yes. Transport is optional and covers Ajman (AED 3,000 per year), Sharjah (AED 3,500) and Dubai (AED 4,500), plus a AED 200 bus booking fee.

items.q: Can tuition fees be paid in installments?
items.a: Yes, installments are available. Choose "Installments" when booking and the administration will contact you to agree on the number and timing of payments.
Yes, there is a special discount for siblings enrolled at the institute. Enter the number of siblings in the booking form and the administration will confirm the discount with you.

items.q: Which documents are required for registration?
items.a: A copy of the student's birth certificate, passport copies of the student and guardian, a copy of the UAE residence visa or Emirates ID, recent personal photos of the student, and the last school-year certificate (except kindergarten). The administration may request additional documents depending on the stage.

items.q: Do the fees include books and uniform?
items.a: No, tuition is separate. Books are charged per term depending on the stage (AED 150 to 300), the 5-piece uniform is AED 300 and the registration fee is AED 300.

items.q: How do I book a seat for my child?
items.a: On the "Book a Seat" page, choose the stage, track and services, enter your details and send the request via WhatsApp in one tap. The administration will contact you to confirm the booking and complete the process.

items.q: Can my child join during the school year?
items.a: Please contact the administration to check availability of seats in the required stage.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Abnauona Institute Abroad ("the Institute") respects the privacy of its website visitors and parents. This policy explains how data is handled when you use the website.

sections.p: When you fill in the booking or contact form, data such as the student's name, date of birth and stage, and the guardian's name, phone number, email and area are collected. This data is not sent to the website's servers; it is passed directly to WhatsApp or email when you press the send button.

To avoid losing data while moving between booking steps, the website temporarily saves what you enter in your browser (localStorage) for up to 3 days. You can clear it at any time using the "Clear data" button.
Data is used only to process your registration request and contact you about it. It is never sold or shared with third parties for marketing purposes.
The website may use analytics tools such as Google Analytics and Meta Pixel to measure traffic and improve the service. They are only activated after you give consent.
You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your data from the Institute's records by contacting us by email or WhatsApp.
For any questions about this policy: abnauna2021@yahoo.com

The Institute may amend these terms at any time; changes take effect from the date they are published on the website.
